executive_risk_memo:
Across the 2025-2026 observation window, World Chain Bridge AnchorStateRegistryProxy (0x90BB48fe3310499Db36437dCAE642F721e32d094) served as the dispute-game anchor state root verifier securing $220.5M in bridged TVL on Ethereum. Forensic analysis of its live control plane reveals that proxy admin authority is held by ProxyAdmin 0xd7405BE7f3e63b094Af6C7C23D5eE33Fd82F872D, which in turn is wholly owned by Safe 0xA4fB12D15Eb85dc9284a7df0AdBC8B696EdbbF1d with zero timelock latency or on-chain delay.

On-chain archival analysis establishes that the Safe was configured as 5-of-8 at both initial proxy deployment (#23,847,851) and the critical implementation upgrade at block 25,830,641 (tx 0x3f6f4122d21807d82d176c92da0b7c9586821e97dbf54126ad9dfa0ec31618cf). During this upgrade, the receipt emitted an intermediate Upgraded(0x2476c911...) event followed immediately by Upgraded(0x8F40Cc98D694AB986F026C5383A181FCc9B6B281) in the same transaction. Subsequently, the Safe executed ChangedThreshold(3) at block 25,978,531 (lowering quorum to 3-of-8), followed by owner removals at block 26,440,617 reaching its current 3-of-6 live topology.

Between contract deployment on 2025-11-21T07:53:59Z and official documentation update PR #159 (commit 54b8dd44) on 2026-08-25T18:03:07Z, a synchronization lag of 277.42 elapsed days (277 calendar days) occurred where developer docs published the superseded 0xD4D7...7099 entry anchored by baseline commit 03436f88. Repository audit of worldcoin/world-chain pins the census window at commit 9611e960 with 60 contract commits and 658 non-contract commits (718 total, advancing to 724 on newer HEAD). In repo_audit, code_before_upgrade_verified is set to false as OP contracts are referenced via submodule without in-repo pre-upgrade source release. Control-plane risk remains elevated due to instantaneous multisig mutability without community timelock protection.
